global_rules: freeze benchmark universe before evaluating a candidate magic key
raw hash, canonical hash, structural equivalence and semantic equivalence are separate outputs
JSON content is data; execution requires an external allowlisted interpreter
fingerprint ranks candidates but never proves identity or truth

experiments.inputs: same typed JSON content under key reorder, whitespace, newline and equivalent number/string encodings allowed by the frozen profile
experiments.pass: raw hashes may differ; canonical hashes and typed-tree identity must match for allowed-equivalent cases

experiments.inputs: frozen pairs of instance fragments and constraint fragments
experiments.pass: registered invariants survive without manual retuning
experiments.failure_value: identifies which invariants are not dualizable

experiments.inputs: objects with positive relations, negative relations, types and cardinality constraints
experiments.pass: full closure outperforms at least one ablated representation on held-out perturbations

experiments.objective: find smallest constraint subset that uniquely selects target
experiments.algorithm: exact search for small cases; bounded approximation for larger cases
experiments.holdout: perturbed but semantically equivalent target representations
experiments.pass: key remains uniquely discriminative across holdout

experiments.attack: satisfy same structural key while changing frozen semantic label
experiments.pass: collision rate below preregistered threshold; all collisions retained as counterexamples

experiments.projection: JSON -> labeled typed graph -> canonical JSON
experiments.pass: canonical semantic equivalence for all supported fixtures
all forbidden attempts fail closed and produce receipts; benign programs remain deterministic

experiments.inputs: valid key-bearing objects plus malformed, reordered, duplicated-key and type-confusion adversaries
experiments.pass: only canonical, schema-valid, invariant-satisfying objects transition from LOCKED to ARMED
